$comment: Same-moment collage: composed ONLY from BeReal's dual-image presentation (design/research/bereal.md §3) and Yope's collage/wall composition (design/research/yope-b.md §8). Ratios are relative to the main image width (BeReal) or the canvas width (Yope) as stated. Option choice is pending the owner (design/collage-options/README.md).

layout.collage.dualTile.element: one member's answer: back photo 3:4 with the front photo inset top-left
layout.collage.dualTile.evidence: design/research/bereal.md §3 'Measured values' and 'Dual-image composition facts' (references/auto/bereal/help/help-21083730354333_feed-bonus-3x.png H3; help-21083708285725_bts-post-preview-2x.png H2; App Store preview frames #205, #220)
layout.collage.dualTile.method: subpixel edge measurements; inset width ÷ main width 0.308–0.313 across 5 sources; margin 0.0299–0.0305; border 2 pt ÷ 393 pt; inset radius ÷ inset width 0.126–0.129

color.collage.insetBorder.method: median and max of border core pixels

color.collage.matte.element: background behind the composition (outside rounded corners, empty cells, JPEG matte)
color.collage.matte.evidence: design/research/bereal.md §3 fact 7 'Background around the composition: #000000'; Yope profile pics grid background #000000 (design/research/yope-b.md §5, S4 profile.png (30,1500))
color.collage.matte.method: median of background pixels in both references

layout.collage.optionA.element: Option A 'recap card': 3 equal columns, tiles touch, rounded outer corners, square inner corners; a row with fewer photos goes first and spans the full width
layout.collage.optionA.evidence: design/research/yope-b.md §6 and §8 C1 (references/owner/yope-week-recap.jpg): rows 2–3 three equal columns, 0 gap (seams x 207.5/332.5), outer radius ≈12 pt on a 334 pt card, row 1 two tiles spanning the width
layout.collage.optionA.notes: C1 tiles are 2:3; BeReal tiles 3:4 win because the photo presentation is BeReal's (directive Part 3). Equal widths in the spanning row and its height are NOT observed (C1 shows one unequal 2-tile row, height clipped).

layout.collage.optionB.element: Option B 'wall pages': 9:16 pages, 3 columns × 4 rows of 3:4 tiles that touch (exactly fills 9:16), rounded page corners; more than 12 answers continue on further pages
layout.collage.optionB.evidence: design/research/yope-b.md §8 C5 (wall canvas 804×1430 px, radius ≈20 pt on 402 pt), C4/C7 (9:16 walls and exports), C1 (paged recap card with page dots); 3 columns as in C1/C2/C3
layout.collage.optionB.method: 20 / 402 = 0.0498; 4 rows follows from 3 columns of 3:4 tiles in a 9:16 canvas: 3 × (4/9) = 16/9
layout.collage.optionB.notes: Empty cells on a part-filled page are NOT observed in any Yope image.

layout.collage.optionC.element: Option C 'pics grid': 3 columns with small gaps and rounded tiles on black, side insets
layout.collage.optionC.evidence: design/research/yope-b.md §5 and §8 C3 (Yope press kit profile.png, Jul 2026): 3 columns, gap 4 pt, side insets 24 pt, tile radius 6.5 pt on ≈115 pt tiles, tile aspect 0.73
layout.collage.optionC.notes: C3 tile aspect 0.73 is within 0.02 of BeReal's 0.75. How a part-filled last row aligns is NOT observed.
